policies.title: DR Congo: Kenyan and Tanzanian citizens have EAC visa-free entry
policies.summary: The EAC's current immigration rule gives citizens of every Partner State visa-free entry into other Partner States, and its current overview names DR Congo, Kenya and Tanzania as members.
conditions: Applies to the ordinary-passport short-visitor baseline for Kenyan and Tanzanian citizens entering DR Congo under current EAC implementation.
The EAC page does not state a numeric stay limit. Required travel documents, border operations, immigration controls, public-health rules and final admission remain applicable.
A still-live FAQ written in 2016 predates DR Congo's 2022 accession and is not treated as a current exception to the later all-Partner-State rule.

policies.title: DR Congo: Mauritian passports require an advance visa
policies.summary: Mauritius's current official traveler table directly says Mauritian nationals need a visa before departure for DR Congo.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mauritian passport holder travelling to DR Congo for a short visit.
The schedule directs the traveler to the DR Congo embassy competent for Mauritius; this is pre-travel consular issuance, not an arrival-issued or electronic visa.
Passport validity, supporting documents, processing, carrier checks and final admission remain subject to the competent authorities.

policies.title: Jordan: four unrestricted nationalities may obtain a visa at the border
policies.summary: Jordan's current border guidance makes border visas available except to restricted nationalities, and the Interior Ministry's exhaustive restricted tables do not include Greece, Grenada, Palau or Timor-Leste.
conditions: Applies to ordinary passports used for short visitor travel. Each passport is outside Jordan's current restricted-nationality tables and therefore does not need prior approval.
The single-entry border visa costs 40 JOD. Passport validity of at least six months and final admission conditions remain applicable.
Use an eligible airport or crossing. Allenby/King Hussein Bridge and Wadi Araba do not issue the ordinary visa on arrival; crossing hours and rules can change.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback says visa on arrival, but Mauritius's current Foreign Ministry table expressly requires a visa before departure and directs travelers to the competent DR Congo embassy.

unresolved.reason: No current DR Congo or Zimbabwe authority directly establishes the ordinary Zimbabwean-passport visitor baseline. A 2019 SADC report is not current enough for promotion, and generic consular filing is not a nationality decision.

Current official sources recovered establish reverse-direction DR Congo passport treatment only. Reciprocity, similarly named Congo rules and generic DRC consular filing do not establish the Republic-of-the-Congo passport baseline.

Jordan's live Morocco row makes arrival issuance unavailable to females aged 16–60 while also saying a visa can be obtained on arrival. The nationality-wide catalog cannot represent this gender-and-age split.

Türkiye splits ordinary Algerian visitors between age-based visa exemption, a visa-required baseline and conditional eVisa eligibility requiring qualifying third-country documents. No one nationality-wide status is accurate.

Türkiye makes eVisa unconditional only below age 15 or above 45; ages 15–45 need qualifying documents and selected airlines while the baseline remains visa-required. No one nationality-wide status is accurate.

Türkiye splits ordinary Libyan visitors between an under-16 or over-45 visa waiver, a visa-required age cohort and conditional eVisa eligibility requiring qualifying third-country documents. No one nationality-wide status is accurate.

Türkiye splits ordinary Iraqi visitors between an under-15 or over-50 visa waiver, a visa-required age cohort and conditional eVisa eligibility requiring qualifying third-country documents. No one nationality-wide status is accurate.
